deviation_notes: The Stage 3 dispatch and brief authorized editing src/commands/init.ts and src/commands/validate.ts, but the implementation intentionally left them untouched. Reviewer calibration is a replay-only benchmark surface that the brief keeps separated from live work and from the canonical `bandit validate` live-state gate; its own `reviewer-calibration validate` command (a required validation command) gates the policy and packets. Leaving init/validate untouched preserves that separation and keeps the diff to the smallest surface area, so allowed_target_files lists those dispatch-authorized surfaces while files_changed records only the files actually changed.

The Stage 3 dispatch authorized editing .bandit/policy/reviewer-calibration.json, and the implementation did so to provide the real-repo replay-only policy. The current implementation_writer role contract does not yet include that specific policy path in allowed_write_surface_families (it lists only .bandit/policy/role-contracts.json, artifact-inputs.json, and gate-determinism-flake-gate.json), so allowed_target_files lists only contract-accepted targets while files_changed records the actual .bandit/policy/reviewer-calibration.json write for PM review evidence, mirroring the BANDIT-074 precedent.

authority_boundary.note: Role-run evidence is append-only evidence. It cannot satisfy coordination history, review evidence, landing evidence, UAT approval, or retrospective authority. Canonical authority for those stages remains in the respective stage artifacts under docs/work/BANDIT-075/.
